general.note: New Bundle: Our Scared Cow Moophisto Bundle (Moophisto and Red Meat Moophisto Skins).
New Variation: Forsaken Xal'atath, available for purchase or from Loot Chests.

heroes.name: Chromie
notes: Once Again the First Time (Level 1): Damage increased from 50% to 55%.
Deep Breathing (Level 1): Damage bonus per stack increased from 0.5% to 0.6%.
Timewalker's Pursuit (Level 1): Damage bonus reduced from 15% to 12%.

heroes.name: Gazlowe
notes: Basic Attack damage increased from 100 to 105.
Health increased from 2275 to 2375.
Deth Lazor [W]: Healing from damage dealt increased from 25% to 30%.
Bomb Toss (Level 20): No longer grants an additional charge. Now reduces the cooldown by 3 seconds.

heroes.name: Greymane
notes: Incendiary Elixir (Level 7): Damage bonus per stack increased from 25 to 30.
Gilnean Roulette (Level 20): No longer reduces the percentage-based Health damage.

heroes.name: Lúcio
notes: Party Mix (Level 1): Quest completion radius bonus increased from 20% to 30%.
Sound Barrier (Level 10): Shield increased from 1296 to 1488.
Slip (Level 13): Lingering duration increased from 1 to 2 seconds.
Summer Anthem (Level 20): Unkillable duration increased from 1.5 to 2.5 seconds.

heroes.name: Medivh
notes: Arcane Rift [Q]: Damage increased from 170 to 185.
Force of Will [W]: Cooldown reduced from 9 to 8 seconds.
Portal [E]: Cooldown increased from 16 to 20 seconds.
Winds of Celerity (Level 1): Now also reduces Raven Form cast time by 0.25 seconds.
Raven's Intellect (Level 1): Bonus increased from 200% to 400%.
Portal Mastery (Level 1): Now increases the Mana cost of Portal by 100%. No longer allows Portal to be cast in Raven Form without dismounting.
Raven Familiar (Level 4): Damage reduced from 121 to 98. Slow reduced from 20% to 15%.
Dust of Appearance (Level 4): Cooldown reduced from 45 to 40 seconds. Now allows Portal to be cast in Raven Form without dismounting.

heroes.name: Mei
notes: Blizzard [W]: Detonation delay reduced from 2 to 1.875 seconds. Detonation damage increased from 75 to 80.
Icing [E]: Cast time reduced from 0.125 to 0.0625 seconds.
Avalanche (Level 10): Cooldown reduced from 90 to 80 seconds.
Ice Wall (Level 10): Cast time reduced from 0.75 to 0.6875 seconds.

heroes.name: Mephisto
notes: Malicious Intent (Level 1): Spell Power bonus increased from 25% to 30%. Duration increased from 2.5 to 3 seconds.
Hateful Mending (Level 4): Mana restored increased from 10 to 15. Healing increased from 70% to 85%.
Static Barrier (Level 4): Shield amount increased from 40% to 50%.

heroes.name: Stukov
notes: Fetid Touch (Level 1): Cooldown reduction increased from 5 to 6 seconds.
Flailing Swipe (Level 10): Damage increased from 48 to 62.

heroes.name: Thrall
notes: Echo of the Elements (Level 1): Now loses 5 stacks upon death.
Spirit Shield (Level 13): Spell Armor reduced from 70 to 50.

heroes.name: Xal'atath
notes: Shadow Mark [Q]: Range increased from 8 to 9. Inner damage increased from 120 to 130 (outer damage remains 50%).
Dark Heart Ritual [W]: Detonation damage increased from 245 to 260.
Void Step [E]: Basic Attack damage bonus per teleport increased from 10% to 15%. Inner damage increased from 120 to 130 (outer damage remains 50%).
Void Volley [D]: Damage bonus per quest stack reduced from 1% to 0.75%. Mythic Reward damage bonus reduced from 50% to 35%.
Anchored Core (Level 1): No longer increases Dark Heart Ritual duration.
Cloak of Shadows (Level 1): Now only grants Spell Armor while actively blinking. The bonus no longer persists for 2 seconds.
Cold Feet (Level 4): Duration bonus increased from 1 to 2 seconds.
Toxic Mark (Level 7): No longer increases Shadow Mark duration. Now benefits from Cold Feet's duration bonus.
Void Eruption (Level 10): Damage per second reduced by 10%. Speed reduced by 10% (travel distance unchanged).
Marked Resilience (Level 16): Shield increased from 160 to 200.
Relentless Whispers (Level 16): No longer increases Attack Speed. Now grants an additional 75% Basic Attack damage per teleport.
Fractured Reality (Level 16): Damage bonus reduced from 25% to 15%.
Harbinger's Consumption (Level 20): Cooldown reduction per hit reduced from 14 to 10 seconds. The three orbs now orbit more slowly.
Unstable Core (Level 20): No longer applies damage over time. Impact damage increased from 45 to 75.

heroes.name: Yrel
notes: Light of Karabor (Level 1): Bonus reduced from 40% to 35% when hitting fewer than 2 targets, and from 80% to 70% when hitting 2 or more.
Divine Steed (Level 7): Lingering duration increased from 3 to 4 seconds.

general: Fixed an issue with the death icon at certain resolutions.
Spell Power no longer increases the Health restored by Hearthstone [B].
Fixed an issue with allied pings on the Party Frame.
Fixed an issue that caused Sapper attacks to instantly hit nearby targets.
Fixed an issue that caused Sapper warning areas to persist indefinitely.

heroes.name: Alexstrasza
notes: Cleansing Flame (Level 10): Fixed an issue where two Cleansing Flames could be active at once.

heroes.name: Auriel
notes: Wrath of Heaven (Level 16): Fixed an issue where the full Spell Power bonus did not apply to healing.

heroes.name: Blaze
notes: Adhesive Petroleum (Level 13): Fixed an issue that granted its Basic Attack damage bonus to other Blaze players without the talent.

heroes.name: Cho
notes: Surging Fist [Q]: Fixed an issue where it did not move toward the cursor when clicked.

heroes.name: Genji
notes: Pathfinder (Level 1): Fixed an issue where Genji no longer auto-acquired nearby targets after Pathfinder expired.

heroes.name: Greymane
notes: Eyes in the Dark (Level 4): Fixed an issue where Greymane no longer auto-acquired nearby targets after Eyes in the Dark expired.

heroes.name: Junkrat
notes: Taste for Explosions (Level 4): No longer increases the damage of the triggering impact.

heroes.name: Li Li
notes: Cloud Serpent [W]: Fixed an issue where Cloud Serpent cast on allied Heroes could become disjointed.

heroes.name: Medivh
notes: Circle of Protection (Level 13): Added a radius indicator to Force of Will's cast guide after selecting Circle of Protection.
Dust of Disappearance (Level 20): Fixed an issue where targeted allies did not auto-acquire nearby targets after Stealth expired.

heroes.name: Tassadar
notes: Shadow Walk (Level 13): Fixed an issue where Tassadar no longer auto-acquired nearby targets after Shadow Walk expired.

heroes.name: Xal'atath
notes: Fixed an issue with Health Regeneration.
Shadow Mark [Q]: Fixed an issue where Structures could be marked in unintended situations.
Dark Heart Ritual [W]: Fixed issues with the self-reveal logic.
Void Volley [D]: Fixed an issue where charge progress was gained when attacking a target with 1 Evasion charge remaining.
Void Acolyte (Level 4): Fixed an issue where it did not properly grant Void Volley charges.
Void Summoner (Level 7): Fixed an issue where the Void Minion did not spawn at Xal'atath's position at cast time.

heroes.name: Xul
notes: Bone Prison [E]: Xul is no longer revealed to the enemy when in the fog of war as Bone Prison activates.
